integrity: The proof independently combines the published signed maximal-chain facet description with the signed-antichain convex-hull description. All radius bounds, equality conditions, center classifications, and contact counts are then derived exactly. Finite enumeration is used only as a corroborative replay on sample posets.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical enriched chain polytope in standard Euclidean coordinates and is not affine invariant. The incenter need not be unique for nonpure posets; the full center set is given explicitly, but no closed formula for its dimension is claimed. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent observation under the name unconditional chain polytope.
title: Height and width are the exact Euclidean radii of enriched chain polytopes
